generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Chinese-built city car sold in the US from 2020: 17.69 kWh pack, AC only (about 3.8 kW, 240 V / 16 A, full charge in about 7 h), no DC fast charging, EPA range 59 mi. EPA rates it as MY2021 only. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/464603/official-kandi-k27-epa-range-59-miles/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/444290/kandi-epa-range-energy-consumption-numbers/
